name: NewMarketTrading SquidRouterModule unbound delegate
summary: SquidRouterModule accepted Axelar express execution while treating caller-supplied sourceAddress and delegate values as authority and never binding the delegate to msg.sender. Forged payloads therefore drove victim Safes to approve and swap valuable assets into attacker pools.
notes: The directly executed Base module was deployed with immutable integration addresses. Its runtime contains no delegation or destruction path and remained unchanged through the campaign's first successful drain.

Rekt reports a $3.98 million gross campaign across 308 successful drain transactions affecting 88 Safes on Base, Arbitrum, and Ethereum. NMT offered a white-hat bounty, but the cited reporting records no returned proceeds; recovery is not netted.
Published campaign estimates range from $3.78 million to $3.98 million because two drained assets lacked contemporaneous price feeds; this record uses Rekt's reported $3.98 million aggregate.
